input.summary: Implemented an in-memory, event-driven Task Management API in TypeScript. Files added: event-bus.ts, services (user, project, task, comment, notification), router.ts, main.ts, demo.ts, and tsconfig.json. Event Bus publish/subscribe is used for inter-service events (task.assigned, task.statusChanged, comment.added). All services own their in-memory stores and do not call each other directly. Router exposes HTTP API per the OpenAPI spec. Demo script starts the server and exercises the full flow (create users, project, add members, create/assign/update tasks, add comments, list notifications). Project compiles with tsc --noEmit.
